constraints: All externally reachable behavior remains command-driven through explicit `og`/`ogd` invocations and is intended to stay scriptable in CI.
Canonical artifacts and plugin manifests stay on `schema_version: 2`, and the adapter interface family remains fixed at `interface_version: 1` until an explicit migration occurs.
Machine-facing contracts stay strict: unknown options are usage errors, identifiers are allowlisted, optimization inputs remain repository-relative, and mixed artifact versions are rejected.
Default autonomy remains observe-safe: application-code writes, dependency changes, unrestricted network access, and deployment actions are denied unless policy explicitly allows them.
goal: Capture the Draft v2.1 `SPEC-v2.md` baseline that defines OutcomeGraph/Steward identities, bounded contexts, CLI contracts, schema-versioned artifacts, adapter interfaces, safety policy, and verification/replay behavior.
